response.description:
Azure Site Recovery
(ASR) now supports replication of virtual machines using Performance Plus
enabled managed disks. With this update, virtual machines using Premium SSD,
Standard SSD or Standard HDD managed disks with Performance Plus capability for
higher IOPS and throughput for their workloads can be protected with ASR for
disaster recovery in the Azure-to-Azure scenario. This support further ensures
performance consistency between primary and secondary regions during
replication, test failover and full failover for such disks. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery Support for Performance Plus Managed Disks
